bagPolicy.summary: The Pyramid Scheme hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Use street parking around the venue or the parking ramp at Weston and Commerce. Carpooling is encouraged, and there are bike racks in front of the building.
parking.quote: The Pyramid Scheme's surrounding area has street parking and the parking ramp at Weston and Commerce can be used.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Pyramid Scheme. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Two full bars serve draft and canned beer, spirits, wine, seltzers and plenty of non-alcoholic options. There's no kitchen, but nearby restaurants deliver to the venue.
concessions.quote: We don't serve food but can recommend some great spots in the neighborhood for you who will deliver delicious grub to The Pyramid Scheme.

accessibility.summary: The entrance is at ground level with no stairs, and accessible restrooms are available. Inside the music room, head right to the end for a ramp to a raised level, and ask any staff member if you need room made or drinks brought to you. Email jeremy@pyramidschemebar.com at least 24 hours ahead to reserve specialty seating.
accessibility.quote: There are no stairs to the building's entrance, which is at ground level.

reEntry.summary: The Pyramid Scheme hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets on TicketWeb or in person at the front bar during business hours; there's no will call for regular tickets. Tickets are scanned from your phone or a printout, so have a clear screenshot of your QR code ready. Artist presale tickets bought outside TicketWeb are held at the ticket counter once doors open and need a photo ID.
ticketPickup.quote: We don't offer a will call option.

gates.summary: Enter at ground level; a cover is charged at the venue door only when there's a show, and all-ages guests must head straight to the live music room after 8pm. The first act usually goes on about an hour after doors open, so arrive at doors if you want a seat.
gates.quote: Usually the first act goes on around 60 minutes after doors open.
